title: varronia iberica
intro: Varronia iberica, commonly known as Black Ironwood or Tilor, is a plant species that belongs to the Bignoniaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Varronia iberica include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties, which contribute to its use in treating infections, wounds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Varronia iberica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
